### 2.37.0 window: launch_notice for the 3.0 launch notice
d: counter.    unit: "1".    priority: P1.    temporality: delta.    attributes: [version_full, agent_engine, outcome, via, entry].    cloudwatch_dimensions: [version_full, agent_engine, outcome, via, entry].  - name: kiro_cli_v3_prompt_total.    description: Decision points of the prompts that move users to 3.0, grouped by outcome (switch, switch_failed when the launch could not be moved onto 3.0, snooze, dismiss, exit when the user quit the 3.0 launch Classic prompt, or suppressed by a prior choice) and by v3_prompt_source (ease_in for users on the 2.0 default, classic for the nudge before a Classic session, launch for the 3.0 launch prompt to existing V2 users who never pinned an engine, launch_notice for the 3.0 launch notice to users who pinned V2 themselves, where dismiss means Keep V2; a launch switch_failed means V3 could not be saved, so that launch still runs on the V3 default and the next launch asks again; the Classic nudge has no dismiss; in 3.0 launch mode a classic switch on a machine that cannot run 3.0 moves the user to 2.0, not 3.0). Records from clients that predate v3_prompt_source form a separate series without that dimension and are all ease_in, so union it in when grouping by source. A classic switch does not stop a launch that passes --agent-engine v1 from reaching the nudge again, so classic outcomes count launches, not distinct users. Suppressed fires on every eligible launch a prior snooze
